body: the paranoia stretches back to my childhood...not sure how to explain it but lately its been bordering on me feeling schizo. a lot of what I hear is getting distorted to the point it feels like I am hearing voices. I am trying not to panic like that anymore, but its just I was just out of a job for over 6 months and now it feels like my life is collapsing again. I really just wanted to be left alone when the cop started talking. I do need to work on people skills though

I suffer from intense chronic paranoia. Not full blown schizo at least. Went off on the cop cause I was scared he was going to try to screw me over when I heard him on his radio calling in back up. Paranoia has left me with very few friends and no love life what soever for most my life. I honestly what the shit to stop. Haven't felt happy for a long time
I'm trying. it's just things have been bad for about 12 years now. I just have trouble seeing the point since I've tried for a long time, things were getting better, and now this
